# About Lantern Supply Co.

Last updated: October 1, 2026
Owner: Priya Whitcomb-Nair

Lantern Supply Co. sells camping lanterns, oil lamps, fuel and parts from two showrooms in
Maryland and from the online store at lanternsupply.example. We make some of what we sell, we
repair everything we sell, and we have been doing both since 1987. This page is the short version
of who we are, for new employees and for customers who ask.

[2] about.md > The company
## The company

Lantern Supply Co. is a Maryland corporation, privately held and family owned. The fiscal year
runs from February 1 to January 31. The company has no outside investors and no debt beyond the
mortgage on the Hagerstown building.

[3] employee-handbook.md > Welcome
## Welcome

Lantern Supply Co. was founded in 1987 by Marjorie and Dale Whitcomb in Frederick, Maryland, and
is still owned and run by the family. Priya Whitcomb-Nair, the founders' daughter, has been chief
executive since 2019. As of October 2026 there are 63 of us across the Frederick headquarters and
showroom, the Annapolis showroom and the Hagerstown warehouse and Repair Center. We are a small
company that sells a small range of things well. Most of the people who buy from us are repeat
customers, and most of them know a great deal about lanterns. Treat them that way.

[4] catalog.md > Base Camp Bundle — $199.99
### Base Camp Bundle — $199.99

One Sentinel 1000 and two Firefly 220 lanterns in one box, for a household that wants one big
light for the main room and two small ones for bedrooms. Bought separately the three lanterns
cost $219.97, so the bundle saves $19.98. The Firefly 220s come in slate. Each lantern carries its
own warranty: 5 years on the Sentinel, 2 years on each Firefly. A bundle can be returned only as a
whole; one lantern from a bundle cannot be returned on its own.

[5] faq.md > Do you sell refurbished lanterns?
### Do you sell refurbished lanterns?

Yes. Lanterns that come back and pass a bench inspection at the Repair Center are sold as Second
Light refurbished items at a discount, with a 1-year warranty. They are sold at both showrooms
and a few times a year online.
